QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] The Gods' Illusions
QuestInfo.0: You absorb the godly power in the seal and see a memory of a god of Tallahart. What does Luce have to say about this?
QuestInfo.1: It's strange for Baldrix to just back off like this. Regardless of whatever he's planning, go ahead to the second seal with Luce.
QuestInfo.2: Apparently, Baldrix wasn't after the second seal. Luce said the wrath of the gods is intensifying, though...
